notes.title: Minor Update (1.2.8)
notes.notes:
Increase fruit drop click speed
Adjust fruit weight physics 
Confine the cursor when using a controller
Prevent the game from running in the background
Add controller use indicator 
Fix occasional controller/mouse click bug
Fix occasional Shop UI freeze bug
General UX improvements and bugfixes

notes.title: Steam Friends Leaderboard and other changes (1.2.6)
notes.notes:
[b]Main Update[/b]
Steam Friends Leaderboard

[b]Minor Updates[/b]
Improve keyboard arrow navigation
Remove post-game score reduction effect
Whitelist common keys for fruit drop
Increase glow stone drop rate for Rescue Mode
Reduce merge explosion power on other fruits
Reduce merge self-applied force
Updated global leaderboard button 
Add optional jiggle effect from settings
Various bug fixes
